shorts.title: Comer On Omar's Family Winery: "Shut Down Because Of Fraud" #Shorts
shorts.narration: Folks, Congressman James Comer went on Fox and dropped a bombshell about Ilhan Omar's family winery. [serious] He said, quote, "That winery has, according to the press, been shut down because of fraud." Comer alleges it sold empty barrels as wine to be aged. The owners' lawyers call any fraud suggestion false and defamatory. [beat] Now, Omar's disclosure valued her stake at fifteen thousand dollars to fifty thousand in 2023. A year later? One to five million. [sarcastic] Her explanation was an accounting error. Folks, that's the only wine that ever aged in a hurry. [beat] Luke 12:2 says, "For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed." [amused] Even in a barrel. So Democrats, answer me this: if a Republican's stake grew like that, would you call it a typo? Subscribe. Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: House Oversight Chairman James Comer said on Fox News: "That winery has, according to the press, been shut down because of fraud."
Comer alleges the winery, eStCru, sold empty barrels to investors under the guise of wine to be aged.
Lawyers for the winery's owners told the Minnesota Reformer that any suggestion of deliberate fraud would be false and defamatory.
Omar's 2023 disclosure listed a stake in eStCru worth $15,001 to $50,000; her 2024 disclosure listed it at $1,000,001 to $5,000,000.
Omar previously attributed the discrepancy to an accounting error.

slides.text: That winery has, according to the press, been shut down because of fraud.
slides.speaker: Rep. James Comer

shorts.title: Blakeman Rides The Subway: Hochul Is "Most Pro-Criminal Governor" #Shorts
shorts.hook: Blakeman rides NYC subway, rips Hochul
shorts.narration: Friends, Bruce Blakeman, the Republican running for New York governor, rode the subway with cameras. [amused] Brave man. He called Kathy Hochul, quote, "the most pro-criminal governor in the United States of America." He said, quote, "The crime in the subways has gone up tremendously under Kathy Hochul and Zohran Mamdani." [beat] Hochul's answer to subway safety was vetoing a bill that required two-person train crews. [sarcastic] Nothing says safety like removing the guy whose whole job is to look around. Proverbs 22:3 says, "A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself." [beat] Hochul's team has been doing that for years. They call it a press release. So Democrats, here's my question: if the subway is so safe, why do New Yorkers keep saying they don't feel it? Subscribe. Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: Bruce Blakeman, the Republican candidate for New York governor, campaigned by riding the NYC subway.
Blakeman called Hochul "the most pro-criminal governor in the United States of America."
Blakeman said: "The crime in the subways has gone up tremendously under Kathy Hochul and Zohran Mamdani."
Hochul vetoed a bill on Dec. 5, 2025 that would have required two-person train crews, an operator and a conductor.

shorts.title: Trump Reportedly Wants The Press Room Turned Back Into A Pool #Shorts
shorts.hook: Trump reportedly eyes press room pool
shorts.narration: Folks, the New York Times reports that President Trump has floated turning the White House press briefing room back into a swimming pool. [amused] Yes, a pool. The Washington Examiner says he raised it with then-press secretary Karoline Leavitt before she left in August, and told her to remove reporters from the room. [beat] Finally, the press corps gets what it always wanted: a deep end. [sarcastic] Imagine the briefings. Sit down, ask your question, and if it's a good one, you get a towel. Ecclesiastes 1:9 says, "there is no new thing under the sun." [beat] Except apparently a new thing under the water. The White House hasn't confirmed the plan, folks. So Democrats and reporters, tell me in the comments: would you rather be grilled or splashed? Subscribe. Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: The New York Times reported on Oct. 20, 2026 that President Trump is weighing a plan to restore the White House press briefing room to its original state as a swimming pool.
Trump reportedly raised the idea with Karoline Leavitt before her departure in August 2026 and told her to remove reporters from the briefing room.
The Washington Examiner's article includes no White House response or direct quote from Trump.

slides.query: James S. Brady Press Briefing Room
